newsitem.title: UK: S. Electric appoints O&M for gas campaign.
newsitem.headline: S. Electric appoints O&M for gas campaign.

text.p: UK regional electricity company (REC) Southern Electric Plc has brought in marketing agency Ogilvy & Mather Direct for an autumn campaign to persuade new and existing customers to use it for gas supplies.
Britain is preparing to free up the gas market to competition in 1998 with a second round of trials based in the south west and south east due to take place early next year.

In its own patch, Southern Electric could find itself facing competition from multi-utility Scottish Power, which snatched control of the local water supplier Southern Water in a 1.68 billion stg takeover earlier this year.

It also has gas and telecommunication interests. Southern Electric said some 50,000 customers out of a total 500,000 households in trials in the south west of England have already switched gas suppliers and next year's trials will mean a further 1.5 million customers can shop around.
The company has a joint venture with Phillips Petroleum for the supply of natural gas.
It currently supplies electricity to some 2.6 million customers.
